newsitem.title: UK: Avalon Oil raises 31.7 mln stg through placement.
newsitem.headline: Avalon Oil raises 31.7 mln stg through placement.

text.p: U.S.-based exploration and production company Avalon Oil said on Friday that it had raised around 31.7 million pounds, net of expenses through placement of shares.
The placement has capitalised the company at 76 million pounds, the company said.
The money would be used to fund a joint venture with Orenburggazprom, a subsidiary of RAO Gazprom, Russia's leading gas company.
The joint venture, Stimul, would explore oil in known oil reserves in the Orenburg gas field in southern Russia.
Stimul has a licence to develop and produce proven and probable oil reserves of 371 million barrels and associated gas reserves of 389 million standard cubic feet.
The shares have been placed at 100 pence each by Henderson Crosthwaite Corporate Finance and dealings on the Alternative Investment Market is expected to commence on April 1.
